english.title: Vehicle - fail to notify of export / destruction
english.standardoffencewording:

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 17 of the Road Vehicles (Registration and Licensing) Regulations 2002 and section 59(1) and (2)(a) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
